answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable bond for 30 epochs and pass random live-work audits before it can earn. Like a ferrous gate rusted shut against cheap copies, the bond makes every extra puppet cost real capital at risk: if audits catch coordinated behavior, the whole cluster is slashed. Honest agents treat rewards as nectar earned slowly on a narrow ledge; an attacker must fund thousands of bonds and lose them all for one detection.
